title: RedactionManifest
description: Handoff contract from 段A (cloud organize) to 段B (async PaddleOCR redaction job). Lists every bucket image that still needs in-image PII masking, with its bucket-relative path and its 10_原始文件/ mirror path. Produced by phase2-synthesis; consumed by scripts/run_redaction_job.py. Only PII is masked — clinical characters are never altered.

patient_dir.description: Absolute path to <patient_dir> (e.g. /abs/PT-XXXX). All file paths below are relative to this directory.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when phase2-synthesis emitted this manifest.

files.description: One entry per image awaiting redaction. MD sidecars are already text-redacted in 段A and are NOT listed here.

id.description: Stable per-file id, e.g. 'f001'. Used to join against redaction_status.json.files[].id.

bucket_path.description: Bucket-relative path to the canonical image inside its 11-bucket subdirectory, e.g. '02_诊断与分期/病理报告/2024-03-15_病理报告_x.jpg'. Never absolute, never prefixed with ocr/. heic/heif are allowed here because phone-photo archives keep the original HEIC in its bucket; 段B transcodes HEIC internally (PaddleOCR cannot read HEIC) before pixel-redacting and emits a browsable JPG. Empty manifests previously happened because this pattern rejected heic/heif and every phone photo silently dropped out of the work queue.

mirror_path.description: Bucket-relative path to the same image's byte-level audit mirror under 10_原始文件/, e.g. '10_原始文件/<subdir>/IMG_0001.heic'. heic/heif allowed (same reason as bucket_path). 段B replaces this mirror copy with the redacted (transcoded, browsable) version.

pii_hint.description: Optional hints (LLM-judged in 段A) about which PII categories the redactor should expect on this image. Advisory only — 段B does its own NER detection and never relies solely on this list.

status.description: Manifest is the work queue; every entry is emitted as 'pending'. Live progress is tracked separately in redaction_status.json.
